repos_data.description: Know what your AI agents cost. API gateway with budget enforcement, session tracking, and MCP tools.
MCP server for AI agent cost intelligence — 23 tools to track spend, optimize models, manage budgets, detect waste, and prove ROI
Live data for AI agents — search, research, markets, crypto, X/Twitter. Pay-per-call via x402 micropayments.
Local-first flight recorder for AI agents: every LLM call, tool call, cost, and loop captured by a transparent proxy. Zero code changes.
Local-first Rust TUI/CLI for auditing AI coding-agent sessions: cost, tokens, latency, failures, and health｜本地优先 Rust TUI/CLI，审计 AI 编程 Agent 会话的成本、Token、延迟、失败与健康度
Official Qorami SDK — JS/Python clients, tool schemas and an MCP server so AI agents check email before sending. https://qorami.fr

Open source AI infrastructure layer. Eight agents run on every request: security, caching, memory, hallucination detection, tamper-proof audit trail. One line of code. Your data never leaves your server.
MCP-native pay-per-tool-call micropayments for AI agents (Solana + USDC + x402)
Shared, versioned memory for AI coding agents — MCP server with git-style history (log/diff/blame) for Claude Code, Cursor & Claude Desktop
MCP server for Circle Agent Stack — wallet management, USDC transfers, and x402 nanopayments via tool calls

Local guardrails for AI coding agents. Wraps any MCP server and blocks destructive tool calls — DROP TABLE, rm -rf, force-push, unscoped UPDATE/DELETE — before they execute. Free, open-source, runs entirely on your machine.
TypeScript SDK for agent spend governance around paid tool calls across MCP, LangGraph, OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini: spend authorization, evidence receipts, refunds, disputes, and settlement.

repo_meta_data.description: Your AI agent just burned $200. AgentGuard stops it at $5. Runtime cost guardrails for AI agents — budget enforcement, loop detection, kill switch. Zero dependencies, MIT licensed.
